title: 既有artifact driver補齊同一FINAL封存bytes合法回復路徑

implementation_summary.scripts/dev_release_artifacts.py: Extracted save_image helper from capture_images so candidate image admission persists byte-verified, fsynced, lease-checked archives identically to baseline. Added restore-final to FAILURE_STAGES.
implementation_summary.scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py: Added candidate-bundle.sha256 and candidate-frontend.json publication preserving exact wire contract for dev_candidate_receipt.py; deferred candidate-frontend.json seal publication until after all verify gates (image readback, config, public, owner) pass; added restore-final command and --target final/candidate option; validated candidate compose bytes, candidate bundle (against sealed candidate-bundle.sha256 digest), candidate archives, and candidate frontend (against sealed candidate-frontend.json digest) before switch; enforced RestoreCAS and protected owner barriers; executed docker compose restore with --no-build, --pull never, --no-deps.
implementation_summary.scripts/test_dev_release_artifacts.py: Added test_save_image_persists_archive_and_rejects_empty_or_differing_overwrite verifying idempotency and rejection of empty/tampered archives.
implementation_summary.scripts/test_dev_release_artifact_driver: Added test_sealed_final_artifact_return_roundtrip verifying full roundtrip (baseline capture -> candidate seal -> rollout -> baseline rollback -> final return from archives without docker build or pull); added test_restore_target_final_matches_restore_final; added test_restore_final_fail_closed_conditions verifying fail-closed failure modes; added test_restore_final_rejects_tampered_fe_even_when_deployment_json_self_digest_rewritten and test_restore_final_rejects_tampered_archive_even_when_candidate_bundle_rewritten verifying counterexample rejection; added test_verify_target_final_does_not_publish_fe_seal_on_gate_failure.
implementation_summary.docs/deployment/dev-exact-artifact-rollb: Documented step 8 for returning to the same admitted final sealed candidate bytes.

explicit_unaccepted_gaps.worker_boundary: Worker is strictly SOURCEONLY with no VM, provider, Root, control, capital, or live operator execution permissions.
explicit_unaccepted_gaps.live_roundtrip: Live VM execution of rollback drill followed by return to final sealed bytes was NOT performed; live roundtrip remains an unexecuted live coordinator obligation.
explicit_unaccepted_gaps.data_preservation_claims: Zero acknowledged data loss (PG/WAL/SHM) on hosted dev VM must be proven by live coordinator post-drill database readback, not by code-level or test fixture claims.
explicit_unaccepted_gaps.frontend_live_symlink: Frontend hosted symlink switch and rollback remain live FE/controller-owned operations on the dev VM.
